subject: Cutting no-shows at Bright Smile Dental Group
body:
Hi Dr. Chen,

Noticed Bright Smile Dental Group has been expanding — congrats on the new location listing. A lot of growing clinics we work with hit the same wall: front-desk staff spend hours a week on reminder calls and rescheduling.

We build automated scheduling/reminder flows that plug into your existing booking system, typically cutting no-shows 20-30% within a month.

Worth a quick look at how it'd fit your setup?

Best,
[Your name]
